title: $251M electric bus facility opens in Miami-Dade County
summary: The South Dade Transit Operations Center, which has 100 spaces for bus charging, opened following two years of construction.

title: City budgets under pressure as revenue growth slows: NLC
summary: Finance officers are less confident about meeting municipal needs as tax revenues plateau, federal aid recedes and infrastructure costs mount, the National League of Cities annual fiscal report found.

title: A Brooklyn apartment building sat vacant for years. A revolving loan program aims to bring it back to life.
summary: The Subordinate Market Rate Revolving Term Loan program seeks to recycle funds from city-backed projects to further New York City’s housing goals.

title: Data centers are testing local governments. Here’s how cities are responding.
summary: After voters made their opposition to data centers clear, local leaders are looking for ways to protect ratepayers, control where facilities are built and secure meaningful benefits.

title: Data center cancellations in Q3 double: Relae
summary: Sixteen data center projects were stopped in Q3, up from seven in the third quarter of 2025. Climate solutions company Relae, formerly known as Carbon Direct, has tracked 70 cancellations since 2024.

title: Florida’s second-largest county adopts AI tech service platform to improve efficiency
summary: Broward County, Florida’s Enterprise Technology Services Division supports 8,000 users across more than 800 departments.

title: New York City plans to charge fee as waste containerization rollout expands
summary: The city’s Department of Sanitation is proposing to charge building owners up to $55 per bin in order to cover installation and maintenance costs. It’s also expanding use of the bins to more neighborhoods.

title: Local government AI readiness corresponds to community size, survey finds
summary: “We can barely keep our heads above water with reactive projects, let alone begin to think big about visionary ideas,” a civil service leader in a small town in Massachusetts said in the CivicPulse and CivicPlus survey.

title: Air taxi developers begin passenger flights under strict FAA guidance
summary: Archer Aviation, Beta Technologies and Joby Aviation are moving closer to federal certification and commercial operations as they conduct piloted flights in cities and states across the country.

title: HUD finalizes rule targeting mixed-immigration-status households receiving aid
summary: The rule could displace tens of thousands of people, housing organizations say. A lawsuit claims the change is illegal and unconstitutional.
